metric_notes.client_latency_ms: descriptive MCP request wall time; this supplemental axis defines no latency SLO
metric_notes.failure_audit: a complete QUERY_FAILED audit/receipt is required within lock_wait_timeout_ms after B+1 returns; success settlement/result audits are forbidden
metric_notes.gateway_replicas: contenders are distributed round-robin over two identical Gateway processes (eight requests per process at width 16), sharing one Catalog, Control PostgreSQL, root ledger, and production binary
metric_notes.inference_boundary: the transitive lock chain establishes only that requests queued behind the held root row; it does not reveal which root epoch a contender read and does not prove a CAS conflict or retry
metric_notes.root_lock_waiters: same-user Control PostgreSQL lock waiters transitively downstream of the acceptance-owned backend holding the target v4_exposure_root_heads row; that transaction holds no other conflicting lock
